**Computer**
- Make and model:
- CPU, RAM, disk:
- Firmware: BIOS (legacy) or UEFI? Secure Boot on/off?
- Screen resolution, touchpad/touchscreen, Wi-Fi chip (if known):

**Greia**
- Image or version (file name from the downloads page):
- How the USB stick was written (balenaEtcher, Rufus, `dd`, …):

**What happened**
- [ ] The installer started
- [ ] Installation finished
- [ ] Greia started after installation
- [ ] Wi-Fi works
- [ ] Sound works
- [ ] Keyboard, mouse/touchpad work
- [ ] Sleep/resume works

What did not work, with the exact message or a photo of the screen:

**Logs (optional, very helpful)**
Installer failure logs saved on the USB stick (see
`docs/release/INSTALLER_FAILURE_LOGS_ON_USB.md`), or from a Linux live system:
`lspci -nn`, `lsusb`, relevant `dmesg` lines.

Remove passwords, Wi-Fi keys and personal data before posting.
